# Agent Skills by Milad Ahmadi

> 48 open-source Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Cline and other AI agents. Install: `/plugin install all-skills --marketplace milad-ahmd/agent-skills` or `npx skills add milad-ahmd/agent-skills`.

## Skills

- [a11y-fixer](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/a11y-fixer/): WCAG 2.2 AA audit that fixes accessibility issues in your code
- [ad-copy-generator](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/ad-copy-generator/): Ad copy for Meta, TikTok, Google and YouTube within each platform's limits, plus an A/B test matrix
- [agent-memory-keeper](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/agent-memory-keeper/): Project memory (MEMORY.md) plus session handoffs (HANDOFF.md) so the next session picks up where this one stopped
- [ai-slop-detector](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/ai-slop-detector/): Score text for AI-sounding writing and rewrite it to sound human, keeping the author's voice
- [api-to-sdk](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/api-to-sdk/): Typed, idiomatic client SDK from an OpenAPI spec or your backend routes
- [app-store-optimizer](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/app-store-optimizer/): App Store and Google Play ASO: keywords, titles, screenshot captions, review replies, A/B tests
- [brand-voice-guide](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/brand-voice-guide/): A brand voice, positioning and personas guide, then rewrites copy on-brand
- [bug-detective](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/bug-detective/): Debug by reproducing first, logging hypotheses and auto-bisecting the commit that broke it
- [changelog-from-git](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/changelog-from-git/): Polished release notes and CHANGELOG entries from git history
- [codebase-explainer](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/codebase-explainer/): Onboarding guide built from a real import graph: entry points, hubs, cycles, Mermaid and an interactive map
- [codebase-time-machine](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/codebase-time-machine/): The story of your repo from git history, as a documentary: eras, cast, plot twists, cursed files
- [commit-craft](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/commit-craft/): Turn messy changes into clean, atomic Conventional Commits
- [competitor-spy](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/competitor-spy/): Competitor analysis of pricing, messaging, socials, ads and reviews, with a SWOT and opportunities
- [content-repurposer](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/content-repurposer/): One video or podcast into 15+ posts: Shorts, Reels, threads, LinkedIn, carousel, newsletter
- [cost-cutter](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/cost-cutter/): Cut cloud, SaaS and LLM API bills with dollar estimates, effort, risk and exact fixes
- [demo-recorder](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/demo-recorder/): Record a real demo GIF or video of your CLI or web app for the README and launch posts
- [dependency-doctor](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/dependency-doctor/): Audit vulnerable, outdated and unused packages with a safe upgrade plan
- [dockerize-anything](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/dockerize-anything/): Production-ready, small, secure Dockerfile and compose for any repo
- [e2e-flow-tester](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/e2e-flow-tester/): Find your app's critical user flows and write Playwright end-to-end tests for them
- [email-campaign-writer](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/email-campaign-writer/): Welcome, launch, cart and newsletter email sequences with subject-line tests
- [env-secrets-guard](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/env-secrets-guard/): Find leaked API keys and secrets before they hit GitHub
- [gh-actions-auditor](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/gh-actions-auditor/): Find pwn requests, script injection and unpinned actions in GitHub Actions, then fix them
- [hook-generator](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/hook-generator/): Scroll-stopping hooks for videos, posts, emails and ads, scored and ranked
- [incident-commander](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/incident-commander/): Run a production outage from triage to mitigation, status updates and a blameless postmortem
- [influencer-outreach](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/influencer-outreach/): Influencer and UGC campaigns: vetting, outreach DMs, briefs and tracking
- [instagram-growth-manager](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/instagram-growth-manager/): Grow and manage Instagram with bio audits, Reels scripts, carousels, captions, hashtags and growth reviews
- [landing-page-roaster](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/landing-page-roaster/): Honest, funny, scored roast of your landing page plus copy rewrites
- [launch-post-writer](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/launch-post-writer/): Turn your repo into an X thread, Show HN, LinkedIn and Reddit launch posts
- [meeting-notes-to-tickets](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/meeting-notes-to-tickets/): Meeting notes into de-duplicated GitHub, Linear or Jira tickets
- [migration-wizard](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/migration-wizard/): Safe, incremental codebase migrations: JS→TS, Jest→Vitest, Pages→App Router and more
- [plan-griller](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/plan-griller/): Grill you on a feature plan against your real code, then write a testable SPEC.md
- [pr-reviewer-pro](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/pr-reviewer-pro/): Senior-engineer PR reviews with severity levels, file:line evidence and suggested fixes
- [prompt-injection-scanner](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/prompt-injection-scanner/): Scan skills, CLAUDE.md, hooks and MCP configs for prompt injection and hidden instructions
- [readme-glow-up](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/readme-glow-up/): Turn any README into a star magnet using only facts from your repo
- [roast-my-github](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/roast-my-github/): Get your GitHub profile roasted with real data, then a scorecard and glow-up plan
- [screenshot-to-component](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/screenshot-to-component/): Screenshot or mockup to a component built with your design system
- [seo-blog-writer](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/seo-blog-writer/): SEO blog posts that rank: intent research, outline, meta tags, FAQ and schema
- [skill-creator-pro](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/skill-creator-pro/): Turn any workflow into a well-written SKILL.md, with a linter to validate it
- [skills-doctor](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/skills-doctor/): Audit your installed skills for broken frontmatter, vague triggers, conflicts and leaked secrets
- [social-analytics-reporter](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/social-analytics-reporter/): Social media analytics exports into a clear report with KPIs, reasons and next actions
- [social-media-calendar](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/social-media-calendar/): Monthly cross-platform content calendar, exported as CSV for Notion, Sheets, Buffer or Later
- [social-media-manager](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/social-media-manager/): One social media manager for LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Threads, Reddit, Telegram, WhatsApp and Google Business Profile: platforms, KPIs, weekly plans
- [sql-optimizer](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/sql-optimizer/): Explain slow SQL queries and get index and rewrite fixes
- [startup-idea-validator](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/startup-idea-validator/): Stress-test a startup idea with a VC, customer and competitor panel, cheap experiments and a verdict
- [test-gap-hunter](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/test-gap-hunter/): Find the riskiest untested code and write real tests for it
- [tiktok-viral-creator](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/tiktok-viral-creator/): TikTok ideas, 2-second hooks, shot-by-shot scripts and retention analysis
- [youtube-script-writer](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/youtube-script-writer/): High-retention YouTube and Shorts scripts with hooks, open loops and B-roll cues
- [youtube-seo-optimizer](https://milad-ahmd.github.io/agent-skills/skills/youtube-seo-optimizer/): YouTube titles, thumbnails, descriptions, chapters and channel audits for more views
